reviews.comment: She would constantly berate students when they were not present in the classroom. Don't take this class if you don't like the outcome of your grade determined by sheer luck and how she's feeling that day. The grading does not make sense, and if you question her about it she will be extremely snarky in response even if you are trying to get help.

Do NOT take this class for public speaking with Landmark! Take another class with a different prof. This teacher is extremely rude to students and not understanding at all to their needs. One of the most difficult classes I have had, which should not have been the case.

I am in this class right now and the grading is very rigid Landmark is a very cookie cutter professor with her rubriks that don't really make sense when presenting a speech as all people are different. Don't take this class if you can

Was very excited to start this class but was very disappointed once the semester started. The grad student messes up frequently on her own syllabus which makes the semester more difficult and also whenever a student asks a question she answers "look at the syllabus" as though she doesn't even know the answer to her own classroom. Awful grading too.

COMM 245 Landmark is a really personable lecturer, and usually extends the discussions past the material in the syllabus which provides you a broader view of world situations. She is a very cut and dry grader, so pay attention to the rubrics. Class regularly gets out early, but you'll use that time to read up to prepare for discussions.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Landmark is very sweet and funny. The class is pretty easy if you pay attention and keep up with your work. We did group activities in breakout rooms every Wednesday, which I didn't love, and attendance counts towards your grade, but other than that I enjoyed the class and learned a lot. I definitely recommend this professor.

Professor Landmark is a very tough grader. Even if your work is astounding, if it doesn't follow her rubric exactly, you will get a bad grade. You are graded on attendance so missing or skipping is not an option. Her lectures end with getting put into groups and then discussing the lecture along with some form of group critical thinking assignment
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Ms. Landmark is tough, but one of my favorite instructors I've ever had. She knew every student by name and took the time to get to know us. She was also always available outside of class if we needed to talk to her about ANYTHING. She really taught us what we needed to know for each speech, although she could be a tough grader.

This grad-student instructor is an extremely tough grader, especially considering this is a class that most are required to take just to graduate. and A grade is "exceptional speech", B is "Average", and C is "Lacking". Pretty high standards, considering the course is meant to help students become more comfortable with public speaking.

To start, I am not a great public speaker. This professor did not take that into account and expected a lot coming from her students. She graded very hard and would be arguably subjective when doing so. I believe she should take the time to understand her students and realize we are not all perfect speakers but rather here to come and learn.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader
